verdict.rationale: Twilio is a programmable voice and phone-number platform, so forwarding a business number to a cell is a fair question for it. However, the pack never documents call forwarding or time-based routing to a mobile number. The closest evidence covers answering, gathering input, recording calls and buying or managing numbers. Those are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not the forwarding capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forward the business number to a cell when the team is away from the desk
